title: Vibe Coding Best Practices: 7 Guardrails That Prevent the Most Common Disasters
summary: Most vibe coders hit the wall within 2 weeks. These 7 guardrails — from real disasters on Reddit and DEV — prevent the doom loop before it starts.
body_markdown: Yes, with the right guardrails. Review every diff before committing (Guardrail 5). Audit auth on every API route (Guardrail 6). Use a platform that handles database, auth, and hosting by default (Guardrail 7). VibeDoctor found that 45% of AI-generated code contains security vulnerabilities — but most of those are catchable with a diff review and an auth audit before shipping.
